description: This PHP class 'HolidayService' provides methods for managing holidays within an HR management system. It includes functions for searching, caching, checking holiday types, saving, and deleting holiday data, working with holiday entities, date ranges, and cache mechanisms.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Service class for managing holiday data, including searching, caching, and validation of holiday types.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Initializes and returns the HolidayDao instance used for database interactions related to holidays.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a holiday entity and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: getHolidaysCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string based on date range for caching holiday search results.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays within a date range with optional pagination.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Gets the count of holidays within a given date range.

methods.name: searchHolidaysAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves holidays from cache or computes and caches the list for a date range.

methods.name: getCalculatedHolidays
methods.description: Calculates the list of holidays (including recurring) within a date range, sorts them chronologically.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a half-day holiday based on holiday length and configuration.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given date is specifically marked as a half-day holiday.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays by their IDs and clears cache.
